_about: AI-1r triage, read handler by handler on 2026-10-03. Checked by coverage.py on every run: a row whose handler or tool is gone, that is now covered by name, or that has no reason, fails the scan. See SKILL.md.

getProjects.reason: Both list every Demo Builder project on disk; the tool also marks the current one.

requestStatus.reason: Same derivation (dashboardStatusService); the handler pushes it to the dashboard, the tool returns it.

republishContent.reason: Both call republishStorefrontContent (settings, code and pages to the CDN). Until 2026-10-23 this was `sync_content`, and `republish` published config.json only (EDS-63).

exportProject.reason: Same file from the same function (createExportSettings); the tool writes for the current project, which set_current_project picks.

import-storefront-zip.reason: add_shared_demo with zipPath runs the same zip-to-repository import (readStorefrontZip + the handler's own refusal check).

configure.reason: The handler only runs the demoBuilder.configureProject command; open_view with view=configure runs the same command.

authenticate.reason: Both run the one Sign In (signInToAdobe): the screen in person mode, the tool in agent mode. The screen's force is the org switch's sign-in, which an agent does through select_org.

check-auth.reason: Adobe authentication status, without the wizard's progress pushes.

check-dalive-auth.reason: DA.live authentication status and the pinned namespace.

check-github-auth.reason: GitHub authentication status with the user and their orgs.

switchOrg.reason: An agent names the org by id and tools run under that target; the forced browser chooser is how a person changes org. ORG_MISMATCH answers point the agent at select_org or sign_in.

get-projects.reason: Adobe Console projects in the selected org, through the same authManager.getProjects.

get-workspaces.reason: Workspaces of the selected Adobe project.

list-org-console-apis.reason: The org's subscribable Adobe services with which are already covered; the wizard variant only adds in-flight picks that exist in the webview.

ensure-mesh-api-subscribed.reason: The mesh deploy core (deployMeshHeadless) subscribes the API Mesh API itself before deploying; add_console_apis subscribes any other API.

checkCompatibility.reason: The tool dispatches this handler itself (through a local run helper the scan cannot follow).

loadDependencies.reason: The tool dispatches this handler itself (through a local run helper the scan cannot follow).

validateSelection.reason: The tool dispatches this handler itself (through a local run helper the scan cannot follow).

get-components-data.reason: The tool was first written as a row over this handler, then narrowed to one component; list_components gives the ids.

getErpDemoControls.reason: The handler is a GET of the ERP's health route (appearance and downtime); set_erp_appearance's description tells the agent to read it with run_erp_rest on 'health'.

copyFromExisting.reason: Both start a project as a copy of one on this machine. The handler opens a picker and then the wizard; the tool takes the source's name and creates through create_project_from_file's own second half, from the same seed the handler opens the wizard with (copySeedFromProject, 2026-10-04).

importFromFile.reason: Both start a project from an exported project file. The handler opens a file picker and then the wizard; the tool takes the file's path and creates through create_project's own path, seeded by the same integration seeding the wizard's import uses (2026-10-03).

addSiteAdmin.reason: set_site_admin with admin:true calls the same addSiteAdmin.

removeSiteAdmin.reason: set_site_admin with admin:false calls the same removeSiteAdmin.

addContentReader.reason: set_content_reader with read:true calls the same addContentReader.

removeContentReader.reason: set_content_reader with read:false calls the same removeContentReader.

waitForSiteAccess.reason: The handler polls until the admin role lands and says which way it went; an agent reads the same roster with get_site_access when it wants to know.

get-datapack-setup-step.reason: Both read the Admin step a pack left (the root category) from its install record, through recordedRootStep; the tool lists it among the project's Finish Setup steps.

check-datapack-setup-step.reason: Both run the pack's read-only root check (checkRecordedRootStep) and save what it found on the record; the tool runs it as one of the Finish Setup steps.

count-datapack-export-items.reason: Both read the project's store through the same pickable-kinds reader; the tool's totalCount is the count for one kind, so an agent counts by listing each kind.

get-datapack-removal-changes.reason: Both read the user's changes with previewChanges; the handler only condenses them into the Uninstall question's counts, and uninstall_datapack names the same changes when it asks.

runProjectsBatch.reason: Each row of the batch runs the same single-project work: runProjectDelete for delete, and for reset the same two paths reset_project uses (the Edge Delivery reset, or the answered reset for a headless project). An agent runs the tool once per project; set_current_project picks the one reset_project resets.

creation-pause-answer.reason: The tool calls this same handler (answerPausedCreation hands the answer to handleCreationPauseAnswer); the wizard's paused-creation button is the person's way in.

log.reason: The webview writing its own log lines to the extension's logger. Channel plumbing.

ready.reason: The wizard webview announcing it has loaded. Channel plumbing.

answerOperationPrompt.reason: The progress modal handing back the button the SC pressed. An agent answers through confirm:true on the tool.

getOperationProgress.reason: A reopened progress modal asking where its operation got to, and taking it back from the notification. Modal plumbing.

validate.reason: Validates one wizard form field and PUSHES the verdict to the webview; the return value carries no outcome.

continue-prerequisites.reason: Resumes the wizard's own check loop from an index held in shared state. An agent uses check_prerequisites and install_prerequisite.

store-dalive-token-with-org.reason: Takes a pasted DA.live credential. An agent must never carry one; connect_dalive hands the paste to the user.

storefront-setup-cancel.reason: Aborts the wizard's in-flight storefront setup through its own AbortController, behind a modal confirmation. An agent undoes with delete_github_repo and cleanup_dalive_site.

use-bundle-setup.reason: Closes the wizard and reopens it pre-filled from a bundle's setup. UI navigation; the job behind it, starting a project from an exported file, is create_project_from_file.

check-erp-integration-holder.reason: Greys the ERP integration out in the Add Integration modal when another project already runs one on this Commerce instance (AB-78). An agent gets the same answer as a refusal from add_integration, add_erp or create_project, before anything is made.

copyAiPrompt.reason: Puts a saved prompt the SC pressed Copy on into the clipboard, with a status-bar line. The clipboard is the person's; an agent already holds the prompt text (visible since 2026-11-14, when `copy` left the UI-verb list).

copy-library-datapack-to-installer.reason: Copies a library pack into the Data Installer's shared catalog. Agents cannot write into the Data Installer: the tool was removed on purpose (D7, datapack simplification Phase 8) and the screen hides the button (`INSTALLER_WRITES_SHOWN`).

datapack-save-question-answered.reason: Shows a one-time tip about a setting after the SC answers Save Your Changes First. An agent answers that question with changes on the tool, and the file says no agent descriptor names it.

finishSetup.reason: The creation end screen's button that swaps the wizard for the new project's dashboard, opened on its Finish Setup guide. An agent reads the guide with get_finish_setup.

fix-datapack-import-with-ai.reason: Opens a Claude chat with a prompt built from the last install's failure record. The agent is already the AI; the failure is in get_datapack_import_status.

fixUpdateWithAi.reason: Opens a Claude chat with a prompt about one update that failed. The agent is already the AI; apply_updates returns what failed.

checkUpdateRows.reason: The Updates window's Check Again, telling each row it re-checked done or waiting on the screen. The handler checks every project; an agent checks one project at a time with apply_updates without confirm.

recheckUpdates.reason: The Updates window's Back to Updates: runs Check for Updates again across every project and hands the rows to the screen. An agent checks one project at a time with apply_updates without confirm.

takeUpdatesRequest.reason: A freshly opened projects list asking whether it should show the Updates window. Screen hand-off, no outcome.

get-datapack-line.reason: Builds the Datapacks card's one line of display text, with a failed or newer dot. The facts behind it are in get_project (its datapack) and list_installed_datapacks.

get-datapack-records.reason: Names the records an install would make, for the install window's Review Records spot check. The file marks it webview-only; an agent gets counts and a few names from preview_datapack_changes and the pack from get_datapack.

get-datapack-removal-scope.reason: Lists which data kinds the Uninstall question will show, from the install record. An agent's uninstall_datapack takes everything the record lists and list_installed_datapacks gives objectCount.

prepareProjectsBatch.reason: Reads the rows for the Reset Selected and Delete Selected questions. An agent meets each question as the tool's own refusal: confirm:true on delete_project and reset_project, and CHANGES_NEED_ANSWER for the user's pack changes.

revealFile.reason: Shows a saved file in the operating system's file browser after Share Demo's Save File. An agent already has the path in export_demo_bundle's answer.

check-store-view-products.reason: No tool asks on its own whether a store view shows guests any products. create_project runs the same check (probeStoreViewProducts) on its storeScope and puts the pickers' sentence in its answer's warnings (EDS-46).

clear-dalive-auth.reason: No tool signs out of DA.live. Whether an agent should be able to is an owner decision.

github-change-account.reason: No tool switches the GitHub account (clear the token, force a fresh sign-in). sign_in covers signing in, not changing who.

check-recorded-datapack.reason: No tool runs this check on its own. create_project_from_file runs the same checkRecordedPack and shows its verdict (datapackNote) before confirm:true, the same shape as check-store-view-products.

getShareDatapackCheck.reason: No tool answers this for a project without Edge Delivery, which is the only kind the screen asks it for: get_demo_package_preview refuses those, and export_demo_bundle's packNote covers only a private library pack, not a pack colleagues cannot get or a custom integration in a private repository.
